text: Westport Albion takes control near the Kingsmoor FC goal, pressing through the central area on the near side of the pitch. They move the ball with fast, vertical passes into Kingsmoor’s final third five times over the last eight minutes, culminating in a header by Rafael Delacroix inside the penalty area. Delacroix’s header is saved by the goalkeeper at the left flank of the goal, keeping the score tied at 2-2. The play shows Westport’s strategic push to break down Kingsmoor’s wide-focused defense with central, direct attacks. [#862] [#moment.facts.final_third_entries_in_window]
